articles.title: Op Sindoor: IAF releases video of Rafale armed with beyond-visual-range Meteor missile, silences sceptics
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) recently released a video, part of 'Op Sindoor,' showcasing its Rafale fighter jets armed with advanced beyond-visual-range Meteor missiles. This strategic demonstration aims to highlight the IAF's formidable air power and operational readiness, effectively addressing any doubts about the Rafale's capabilities and bolstering confidence in India's defence preparedness. It signifies India's continuous efforts to modernize its air force.

articles.title: At R-Day parade, India showcases 'Sindoor' valour, as DRDO missile, Bhairav battalion make debut
articles.summary: During the Republic Day parade, India showcased its 'Sindoor' valour, symbolising national strength and military prowess. The event featured significant debuts, including a new DRDO-developed missile, highlighting advancements in indigenous defence technology. Additionally, the Bhairav battalion made its first appearance, underscoring the continuous modernization and operational readiness of India's armed forces, crucial for national security and defence preparedness.

articles.title: Can India be a player in the computer chip industry?
articles.summary: Tejas Networks, a key Indian supplier for national mobile and broadband networks, underscores the critical need for a reliable computer chip supply. Co-founder Arnob Roy highlights how supply chain resilience is vital for maintaining India's digital infrastructure amidst global shortages. This emphasizes domestic technological self-reliance and strategic planning for national security and connectivity.

articles.title: Navy shipbuilding stands to get $27 billion in funding in 2026
articles.summary: US House and Senate appropriators have approved an additional $6.5 billion in funding for the White House's shipbuilding goals for fiscal year 2026, also correcting prior accounting errors. This substantial financial backing underscores a bipartisan commitment to enhancing naval capabilities and strengthening national defense, ensuring future maritime dominance and security for the nation.

articles.title: 77th Republic Day: Military might, with a dash of Sindoor
articles.summary: India's Republic Day celebrations, the first post-Operation Sindoor, prominently showcased the nation's robust military might. The grand display featured advanced fighter jets, indigenously developed missiles, newly raised units, and lethal weaponry. This demonstration underscored India's growing defence capabilities, commitment to self-reliance, and strategic strength, reflecting national pride and operational readiness for SSB aspirants.
